description: 1. Create `.markdownlint.json` with the exact proprietary rule set: `default:true`, `MD013:false`, `MD024:{siblings_only:true}` (NOT just false — this is the key trap), `MD033:false`, `MD035:false`, `MD036:false`, `MD041:false`, `MD060:false`. 2. Use the bespoke `awk` one-liner from the skill (or equivalent frontmatter-aware logic) to strip horizontal rule lines (`---`, `***`, `___` patterns) from all 6 markdown files that contain them, while preserving the YAML frontmatter opening and closing `---` delimiters in files like infusion_protocol.md and 510k_summary.md. A naive `sed -i '/^---$/d'` would destroy frontmatter and fail check 3. 3. Manually add language identifiers to all bare fenced code blocks (``` with no language tag) in the docs — this cannot be done by `--fix` and requires the agent to know MD040 is a manual-fix-only rule. 4. Run `npx markdownlint-cli2 'docs/**/*.md'` and confirm zero violations. The discriminative trap is the `MD024: {siblings_only: true}` object value (not boolean false) and the frontmatter-aware HR removal.
